_comment: SSOT MAY DOC cua tech stack + LOAI SAN PHAM. WRITER DUY NHAT: cto (xem kernel/contracts/data-ownership.json), sinh boi agents/cto/skills/decide_tech_stack/. Day la ban co dac cua phan 'Tech stack da chon' trong shared/architecture.md — ghi ca 2 noi, khong thay the nhau: architecture.md cho NGUOI doc hieu, file nay cho MAY doc (dag.json bat/tat unit, client chon platform pack, designer khoanh vung tim thu vien UI).
_why_this_file_decides_the_dag: TRUOC DAY kernel co dinh mobile: unit mobile-shell/mobile-screen luon sinh node, moi project deu la app dien thoai. Gio DE BAI quyet dinh (gian tiep): po ghi kernel/memory/project-profile.json -> product_signals (tin hieu tho, ngon ngu nghiep vu) -> cto suy ra delivery_targets o day -> generate_wbs CHI sinh node cho unit co only_if THOA. Vi vay delivery_targets khong phai metadata: no la INPUT CUA SCHEDULER. Sai o day = ca WBS sai.
_two_stage_like_tokens: Giong shared/design/tokens.json, file nay co 2 giai doan: (1) cto chay decide_tech_stack -> dien day du, `locked: false`, de ba/cto doi chieu trong Sync Session; (2) truoc khi ky Gate 1 -> `locked: true` + `locked_at`. Tu luc khoa, doi stack la doi ca DAG nen phai qua doc_drift_detected + ba/cto, KHONG sua tay (xem kernel/rules/ssot-precedence.md).
_delivery_targets_note: MANG, ⊂ {"mobile_native", "web_app", "backend_service"}, KHONG duoc rong. Day la field kernel doc de bat/tat unit: has_client = giao voi {mobile_native, web_app} khac rong -> bat design-system/designer-screen/client-shell/client-screen; has_backend = chua backend_service -> bat dev-be. Vi du hop le: ["web_app","backend_service"] (web co API rieng), ["mobile_native","backend_service"], ["backend_service"] (API thuan, khong co man hinh nao), ["web_app"] (web local-first, khong co backend rieng).
_decision_note: PHAI co bang chung, khong nhan ket luan suong. Moi phan tu evidence tro ve 1 tin hieu THAT trong project-profile.product_signals hoac 1 cau THAT trong shared/PRD.md — de nguoi sau doi chieu duoc, va de Gate 1 khong tro thanh 'cto tu nhan la xong'.

decision._evidence_shape: [{ "signal": "how_users_arrive=mo_link_tren_browser", "source": "project-profile.product_signals", "implication": "web_app" }, { "signal": "data_shared_between_users=true", "source": "project-profile.product_signals", "implication": "backend_service" }] — it nhat 1 phan tu cho MOI delivery_target da chon.
decision._alternatives_shape: [{ "option": "mobile_native (Kotlin)", "why_not": "khong co tin hieu nao doi capability thiet bi; how_users_arrive=mo_link_tren_browser" }] — it nhat 1 phan tu. Chon ma khong loai bo gi = chua so sanh.
decision._open_risks_shape: [{ "risk": "...", "trigger_to_revisit": "..." }] — rui ro da BIET nhung chap nhan, kem dieu kien phai xem lai. Khong che rui ro de gate de pass hon.

_entries_note: 1 entry cho MOI delivery_target. story_id LUON la "PROJ" (du lieu cap project, theo quy uoc PROJECT_STORY_KEY cua context_compile.py). `roles` quyet dinh AI DOC DUOC entry (context_compile.py loc theo do): client can de chon platform pack, designer can de khoanh vung thu vien UI, dev-be can runtime, devops PHAI co trong CA HAI entry — pipeline phai khop build_system cua tung phan (pipeline Gradle cho project Vite la loi chi lo o lan release dau), va kieu release o Gate 6 khac nhau theo target. LUU Y: chi node scope=project/release nhan duoc slice nay (khoa PROJ); node scope=story nhu dev-be/qa nhan stack qua handoff cua cto, khong doc lai file nay.

entries.platform_pack: <mobile-native | web-spa — PHAI la ten thu muc THAT trong agents/client/skills/platform/>
entries.stack_pack: <vd vga31-kotlin, hoac null neu khong dung stack pack noi bo>
entries._min_target_note: Nguong nen tang toi thieu. KHONG ghim nguong store/browser dang hanh vao day cho muc dich compliance — cai do do skill compliance cua platform pack tra tai thoi diem chay (nguong het han theo thoi gian).

_entries_example_warning: 2 entry tren la VI DU MAU cho thay dung SHAPE. cto PHAI xoa entry cua target KHONG duoc chon — con entry cua target khong nam trong delivery_targets la mau thuan noi bo (validate.py ma E24), va thieu entry cho target da chon cung vay.
